summary.text: Morgan Hudson is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 15, 2026 Republican primary.
A business owner, she is president of the Frederica Senior Center and a member of the Kent County Board of Adjustments and Appeals, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Morgan Hudson earned a high school diploma from St. Thomas More High School and a bachelor's degree from Cabrini College in 2013.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hudson described herself as a lifelong Delawarean, small business owner, community volunteer and mother.
Hudson said she is running to represent District 33 residents in Dover, fight for affordability, and protect Delaware's farmland and rural character.
She said growth should pay for growth, with developers contributing toward infrastructure, and that she supports increasing funding for the Farmland Preservation Program.
